description: This file contains unit tests for the DeepLinkParser module, which appears to parse custom URL schemes for an application. It includes functions to set up code payloads and to generate agent actions, along with a test suite verifying parsing behavior for different URL formats, including agent and gateway links, with various validation checks.

classes.name: DeepLinkParserTests
classes.description: A test suite struct containing multiple test cases to verify parsing logic of deep links for agents and gateways.

methods.name: setupCode
methods.description: Creates a base64 URL-safe string from payload string, replacing certain characters and stripping padding.

methods.name: agentAction
methods.description: Constructs a DeepLinkRoute.agent object with specified parameters, used in test assertions.
